prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Select Your Pet's Preferred Activity Style", "Choose how active or quiet you would like your companion to be on your desktop."]
1: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe", "Your pet state is saved automatically to your profile"]
2: ["Choose Companion Voice Accent", "Select how your pet sounds when greeting or seeking attention on your desktop.", "Set Voice Accent"]
3: ["Initializing desktop window overlay"]
4: ["Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop", "Right-click your companion anytime to access controls, switch modes, or hide them.", "Start Desktop Experience"]
5: ["Select Your Desktop Companion Journey"]
6: ["Choose Visual Style Preset", "Select the art style base for your companion before generating or custom painting."]
7: ["Desktop Display & Overlay Setup", "Ensure your companion spawns on your primary screen or select multi-monitor mode.", "Set primary screen for companion", "Confirm Display Settings"]
8: ["Quick Desktop Mouse Gestures", "Single click to pet, double click to talk, and drag to place anywhere on screen.", "Got It!"]
9: ["Signing in backs up your pet's personality and unlocks cross-device sync securely.", "Your pet progress is protected instantly upon sign-in."]
